## Purpose and Scopesvg image

The `updaterhtml` command applies patch files to HTML context files, enabling incremental updates to HTML-formatted project contexts. This command is part of the HTML workflow's update subsystem and serves as the application counterpart to `updatecontexthtml`, which generates patches.

For generating patches between HTML context versions, see [updatecontexthtml](/ray0404/Contexter/5.3.4-updatecontexthtml). For the Markdown equivalent of this command, see [updater](/ray0404/Contexter/5.3.2-updater). For an overview of the update system, see [Update Management](/ray0404/Contexter/3.3-update-management).

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md33](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L33-L33) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py52](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L52-L52)

---

## Command-Line Interfacesvg image

The `updaterhtml` command is registered as a console script entry point that invokes the `main()` function in the `updater_html` module.

```px-2
updaterhtml <patch_file> <target_html> [output_html]
```

### Argumentssvg image

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `patch_file` | File path | Yes | Path to the patch file (`.md` or `.html` format) containing the differences to apply |
| `target_html` | File path | Yes | Path to the HTML context file to be updated |
| `output_html` | File path | No | Path where the updated HTML context will be written. If omitted, overwrites `target_html` |

### Cross-Format Supportsvg image

A key feature of `updaterhtml` is its ability to apply patches in either Markdown or HTML format to HTML context files. The patch format is automatically detected based on file extension and content.

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md33](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L33-L33) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py39-54](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L39-L54)

---

## Functional Overviewsvg image

**Diagram: updaterhtml Command Flow**

The command performs four primary operations:

1. **Patch Parsing**: Reads and parses the patch file, auto-detecting format
2. **Context Parsing**: Extracts current file contents from the target HTML context
3. **Patch Application**: Applies unified diff patches to individual file contents
4. **Reconstruction**: Rebuilds the complete HTML context with updated contents

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py131-176](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L131-L176) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py180-216](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L180-L216)

---

## Patch Application Processsvg image

**Diagram: Patch Application Sequence**

### Key Processing Stepssvg image

1. **Patch Format Detection** ([![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py131-137](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L131-L137))

   - The `parse_patch_file()` function examines the file extension
   - `.html` files invoke `_parse_html_patch()`
   - All other files invoke `_parse_md_patch()`
2. **HTML Patch Parsing** ([![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py163-176](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L163-L176))

   - Uses BeautifulSoup to parse HTML structure
   - Locates `<div class="diff-container">` elements
   - Extracts `data-path` attribute for file identification
   - Retrieves diff content from `<pre>` elements
   - Converts text to patch objects using the `patch` library
3. **Markdown Patch Parsing** ([![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py139-161](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L139-L161))

   - Uses regex pattern to identify `--- DIFF FOR: <filepath> ---` headers
   - Extracts diff content from fenced code blocks (```)
   - Converts to patch objects for application
4. **Target Context Parsing** ([![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py111-129](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L111-L129))

   - Parses target HTML to extract current file contents
   - Creates dictionary mapping file paths to current content
   - Handles both regular files and binary file markers
5. **Patch Application**

   - Iterates through each file in the patch dictionary
   - Applies unified diff patches using the `patch` library
   - Updates the files dictionary with new content
6. **Context Reconstruction** ([![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py180-216](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L180-L216))

   - Generates complete HTML structure with CSS styling
   - Applies syntax highlighting using Pygments
   - Wraps each file in `<div class="file-container">` with metadata
   - Writes the complete HTML document

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py111-176](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L111-L176) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py180-216](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L180-L216)

---

## Cross-Format Patch Compatibilitysvg image

**Diagram: Cross-Format Patch Application**

The `updaterhtml` command normalizes patches from different formats into a common internal representation (dictionary of patch objects), enabling cross-format compatibility. This design allows:

- **Markdown patches** generated by `updatecontext` to be applied to HTML contexts
- **HTML patches** generated by `updatecontexthtml` to be applied to HTML contexts
- **Format-agnostic workflows** where patch generation and application can use different formats

The auto-detection mechanism ([![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py131-137](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L131-L137)) examines file extensions to determine the appropriate parser, while both parsers produce the same output format: a dictionary mapping file paths to `patch` library objects.

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py131-176](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L131-L176) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md33](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L33-L33)

---

## Integration with Update Workflowsvg image

**Diagram: Integration with updatecontexthtml**

The `updaterhtml` command is designed to work in tandem with `updatecontexthtml`:

1. **Generation**: `updatecontexthtml` compares two HTML context versions and generates a patch file
2. **Distribution**: Patches can be stored in version control, transferred, or shared
3. **Application**: `updaterhtml` applies stored patches to target HTML contexts
4. **Versioning**: Enables incremental updates without full context replacement

This architecture supports distributed workflows where patches serve as lightweight change descriptors.

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md32-33](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L32-L33)

---

## Implementation Detailssvg image

### Module Structuresvg image

The `updaterhtml` command is implemented in the `updater_html.py` module, which follows the standard Contexter architecture pattern:

- **Entry Point**: Registered in `setup.py` as `updaterhtml=updater_html:main` ([![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py52](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L52-L52))
- **Utility Dependencies**: Leverages shared functions from `contexter_utils.py`
- **External Dependencies**: Uses the `patch` library for diff application and `beautifulsoup4` for HTML parsing

### Core Utility Functionssvg image

| Function | Module | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `parse_patch_file()` | `contexter_utils` | Auto-detects and parses patch files (MD or HTML format) |
| `_parse_html_patch()` | `contexter_utils` | Extracts patch objects from HTML patch structure |
| `_parse_md_patch()` | `contexter_utils` | Extracts patch objects from Markdown patch structure |
| `parse_html_constructor()` | `contexter_utils` | Parses HTML context files into file dictionaries |
| `rebuild_html_constructor()` | `contexter_utils` | Generates complete HTML context from file dictionary |

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py111-236](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L111-L236) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py23-54](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L23-L54)

## Technical Considerationssvg image

### Patch Format Detectionsvg image

The command relies on file extension heuristics for format detection. While `.html` extensions trigger HTML parsing, all other extensions (including `.md`, `.patch`, or no extension) default to Markdown parsing. This means patch files should be named appropriately to ensure correct parsing.

### In-Place Updatessvg image

When no output file is specified, `updaterhtml` overwrites the target HTML context file. Users should ensure they have backups or version control in place before performing in-place updates.

### Binary File Handlingsvg image

Patches cannot modify binary file markers (`SKIPPED (BINARY)` entries). If a patch attempts to modify a binary file entry, the patch application may fail or produce unexpected results.

### Patch Compatibilitysvg image

Patches generated by `updatecontexthtml` are guaranteed to be compatible with `updaterhtml`. However, manually created patches must conform to the unified diff format expected by the `patch` library.

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py131-137](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L131-L137) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py163-176](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L163-L176)
